filters.basis: The table gives each nebula a probability of belonging to M105 and not to NGC 3384 or the light between the galaxies (fM105, ReadMe note 3). A dot is drawn where that is above one half: a presentation choice of the threshold, on the paper's own number.

frame.converter: Each sky position onto the plane the picture stands on, facing the Sun (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

meaning: Planetary nebulae of M105 with measured velocities, from Hartke et al.'s (2022) table: one dot per nebula at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the planetary-nebula color M31's and M33's dots share. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
